title: Set Matrix Zeroes
statement_short: Given an m x n integer matrix, if an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0's in-place.
constraints: m == matrix.length, n == matrix[i].length, 1 <= m, n <= 200, -2^31 <= matrix[i][j] <= 2^31 - 1
hint: Grid dimensions up to 200 permit O(m \* n) time while using first row/col as flag sets to achieve O(1) extra space.
why_not: Right: HashMap / Hash Set records zero row and column locations in O(m \* n) time (or uses first row/col as flag sets to achieve O(1) extra space). Not Two Pointers: Scanning inward from matrix ends does not identify arbitrary zero cell coordinates efficiently. Not 2D DP: Subproblem memoization is unnecessary for linear row/column zero propagation. Not Bit Manipulation: Bitmasks can track zero rows/cols up to 64 bits, but do not scale to general matrix sizes.
